newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Penoles dropped to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Penoles dropped to sell.

text.p: Paribas dropped its recommendation on Mexican silver giant Penoles to sell from buy on Friday.
-- "The earnings downgrade is predominately a response to the much weaker outlook for silver, following this week's collapse in the silver price," wrote Nigel Kieser in a report.

-- Kieser also cited Penoles' withdrawal from its planned 60 percent stake in Peru's La Oroya smelter, announced on Thursday. He said that the decision was likely to upset the market, as it signifies a loss in potential long term earnings.
-- The world's largest silver producer has also been hit by lower prices of silver, which plunged over 40 cents per ounce just this week, Kieser said.
-- Penoles stood at 34 pesos at early trading, up 10 centavos from Friday's close.
